components_analyzed.reason: IBM AIX 7.2 reached end of service on April 30, 2025. No further security patches are released by IBM.

COBOL-2014 is an ISO standard revision. The language is still technically supported (ISO COBOL 2014 / GnuCOBOL), but is widely considered a legacy language with diminishing developer talent pool and no active ecosystem growth. Classified as OUTDATED due to limited ecosystem support.
Oracle Database 19c is a Long-Term Release supported until April 2027 (Premier Support). Currently receiving full security patches and updates.
